title: Subschema - Radio
description: An object describing radio button settings

key.description: The unique lookup id for the group of buttons. The key ``state`` is reserved; do not use it.

label.description: A section heading printed above the radio button or group of radio buttons

initial.description: Initial radio button set to selected

values.description: An array of user-facing strings, one per radio button, which also function as the buttons' values
